The Five Rivers of Punjab (Panjnad) - Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, Beas, and Sutlej.
Confluence Formation - Jhelum and Ravi fall into Chenab separately. -Beas joins Sutlej. - Sutlej and Chenab join to form the Panjnad.
Panjnad River - Flows 44 miles (71 km) southwest to its junction with the Indus River near Mithankot.
Indus River - Drains into the Arabian Sea.
Location of Panjnad River - Located in the Punjab province of Pakistan.
Jhelum and Chenab Confluence - Jhelum and Chenab meet at Trimmu, near Jhang.
